episode_title: Automate the Follow-Up. Keep the Human Connection. | Kate Wells

real_qa.q: How does Glimmer Marketing Systems use AI to automate business backend systems?
real_qa.r: Kate Wells identifies backend system issues for clients and uses AI to build and automate solutions to address them. She emphasizes that understanding how to prompt AI correctly and build systems allows businesses to do the same amount of work faster, resulting in incredible ROI. The strategy involves seeing what pain points exist in a company's operations and finding ways to help solve them through AI automation.
real_qa.requete: Glimmer Marketing Systems AI automation backend

real_qa.q: Why did Kate Wells transition from general marketing to AI-powered backend automation?
real_qa.r: After doing all marketing work for multiple businesses and feeling underpaid, Wells conducted research to identify an industry with low competition where she could be successful within ten years as AI advances. She discovered backend systems automation was a gap in the market, and once she started telling people about it, she realized it was the right opportunity for her business.
real_qa.requete: Kate Wells marketing to AI automation transition

real_qa.q: What advantage does being one of ChatGPT's earliest users provide for an AI automation business?
real_qa.r: Kate Wells was in ChatGPT's 1% of earliest users and taught herself prompt engineering right when the tool came out because she knew she had to be ahead of the game to win and be successful. She has spent the last three years teaching herself everything with AI for research, planning, and tracking, which has been starting to pay off significantly in her business.
real_qa.requete: ChatGPT earliest users prompt engineering advantage

real_qa.q: How does relationship-based business protect against AI disruption?
real_qa.r: Kate Wells argues that if your business isn't people-based and relationship-based, you need to turn it into one, because anything that doesn't require a relationship will be able to be done by AI online. The strategy is to meet as many people as possible, positively influence them, do the actual work, and then reap the emotional relationship benefit.

real_qa.q: Why is Nashville becoming an alternative to Austin for tech and business relocation?
real_qa.r: Companies like Oracle are moving from Austin to Nashville because Austin has become very expensive with high property taxes. Nashville is described as approximately ten years behind Austin in development, but with similar characteristics like beauty, greenery, and a growing business ecosystem, making it an attractive alternative as Austin property costs have skyrocketed.
real_qa.requete: Oracle Nashville Austin relocation property taxes

guest.bio_context: Kate Wells moved from Austin, Texas to Nashville, Tennessee and joined the Williamson County chapter of BNI. She originally studied sociology at the University of Texas at Austin after being denied admission to Berklee College of Music in Boston. She taught herself prompt engineering and AI as one of ChatGPT's earliest 1% of users, and built a business automating backend systems and workflows for small businesses using AI tools.
